label: sdc01_0100_sister_01
text: You’re [VAR 0x0100(0000)] or whatever, right?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0100_sister_02
text: Let me guess—you want to pair up with one of us\npoor, lonely Blueberry students?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0100_sister_03
text: Gosh, it’s so sweet of you to go out of your way\nlike that. What would we ever do without you?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0100_sister_04
text: Wait, but you’re the one who came to talk to us.\nWhat are you, some kinda weirdo?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0100_sister_05
text: Oh yeah. So my little brother here has been\nall googly-eyed over you since yesterday.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0100_sister_06
text: He wouldn’t stop talking about you—even at\nhome. I seriously couldn’t get him to shut up.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0100_brother_01
text: S-Sis! What’re you tellin’ h[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0202)]imer that for, dummy![VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0100_sister_07
text: HEY! Watch who you call “dummy,” if you know\nwhat’s good for you![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0100_sister_08
text: Look at him, being all shy...[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0100_sister_09
text: See, my brother’s no good at talking to people.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0100_sister_10
text: He’d probably never work up the nerve to ask\nyou himself, but he’d really like a battle with you.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0100_sister_11
text: C’mon, please? Just have a battle with my\nbrother, would you?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0100_sister_12
text: Huh? What’s that? I couldn’t hear you.\c\nWhen you’ve cleared your throat of whatever\nthat was and are ready to say yes, lemme know.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0100_sister_13
text: Well, what do you know—turns out you’re sorta\nnice. This’ll make my brother real happy.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0100_sister_14
text: Chin up, Kiki!\c\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)] says [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0100)]she’ll battle you![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0100_brother_04
text: W-wowzers, really?! You don’t mind?![VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0100_sister_15
text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0201)]HShe doesn’t mind a bit.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0100_sister_16
text: Get to your positions, you two. Everybody else,\nclear out. Make some space![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0100_brother_05
text: I-I got this![VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0100_student1_01
text: Good show!

label: sdc01_0100_bbteacher_01
text: Nicely done, kids! Nothing like a friendly battle\nto get to know someone![VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc01_0100_brother_06
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]W-wowzers! You sure are strong,\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0100_brother_07
text: That was some kinda battle!\c\nI bet you’re something else when you’re not\nholdin’ back, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0100_sister_17
text: You really aren’t half bad. Kiki’s nearly as strong\nas I am, you know.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0100_brother_08
text: I dunno about that...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0100_sister_18
text: This orienteering thing... We’re supposed to\ngroup up in pairs, right?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0100_sister_19
text: You should go ahead and pair up with Kiki, then.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0100_brother_09
text: What?! No, Sis, don’t—![VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0100_sister_20
text: Don’t what? It’s not like we can pair up. Or were\nyou hoping to partner with some other rando\r\noutsider instead of [VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0100_brother_10
text: Well...no, but... Aw man...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0100_sister_21
text: Don’t worry. He’s just being shy.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0100_sister_22
text: I’ll go find some chump to pair up with too.\nWatch out for my little bro, you.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0100_caretaker_01
text: Looks like you’ve all paired up![VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: sdc01_0100_caretaker_02
text: Let’s go ahead and mark where you’ll be going\non those Rotom Phones of yours.[VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: sdc01_0100_caretaker_03
text: Now then, off you go to do some exploring![VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: sdc01_0100_caretaker_05
text: Oh, and if you find yourself in need of any\nPotions or Poké Balls or the like...[VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: sdc01_0100_caretaker_06
text: head on over thataway and stop by Peachy’s!\nThey’d be happy to set you to rights.[VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: sdc01_0100_brother_12
text:
So it looks like...we should probably start with
the signboard at...[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Loyalty Plaza[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]...\c
That’s out past the apple orchards on the west
side of the village...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0100_brother_13
text: It’s close by. And I figure it might, um, make\nsense to...y’know...visit them all in order...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0100_brother_14
text: I’ll probably just get in your way if I stick too\nclose, so I’ll just...follow you from a safe distance![VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0100_caretaker_04
text: Welcome to Kitakami Hall! We’re glad to have\nyou here. Relax and enjoy yourself![VAR 0x0114(0045)]

label: sdc01_0100_student1_02
text: Nice to meet you, Carmine!

label: sdc01_0100_student2_01
text: I felt bad leaving this kid on his own, so I guess\nI’ll partner up with him.

label: sdc01_0100_student3_01
text: I can’t wait to see what Pokémon we discover\nwhile looking for those signboards!

label: sdc01_0100_sister_23
text: Let’s do this, outsider—I mean, uh, totally\nordinary guy![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0100_bbteacher_02
text:
Finally time to kick off this school trip in earnest.
Get out there and do some orienteering!\c
You’ve come all the way here to Kitakami, so you
should see everything it’s got to offer![VAR 0x0114(0042)]
